bio: Hugo Cardona has been a dedicated staff member at the Dean of Students Office for the past three years. In the role of Administrative Coordinator, he has supported a range of administrative and financial functions while also contributing to campus life through event photography and special projects such as the Portraiture Project and Cultural Rhythms. He takes pride in helping bring community-centered initiatives to life and ensuring smooth day-to-day operations behind the scenes. His work includes supporting student organizations through the grants process. Service on leadership committees reflects his strong commitment to fostering collaboration, inclusion, and excellence within the college environment. Hugo holds a degree in Information Systems with a specialization in Project Management from the University of North Texas—Go Eagles! Area Office of Culture & Community Role Central
